analysis:
The PR changes only CHANGELOG.md (lines 11-39 on head): it renames the v0.10.9 candidate section to published and adds a v0.10.10 candidate section. The new section describes 'darkbloom waitlist', account-level waitlist approvals for new sandbox setup and new cluster pairing, and a 'cluster local' bypass. No source code, protocol, attestation, key-handling or cache-storage behavior is changed in the supplied evidence, so no threat-model assets are directly regressed.

Security-relevant claims to verify in the code PR, not in this docs-only diff:
(1) TB-013/T-061: the sandbox setup gate is client-side. The changelog says that if the coordinator does not offer waitlists, setup proceeds as before. That fail-open is documented and is a product gating choice, not a security control. It does not change the installer download or run trust boundary.
(2) TB-012/TB-014: the 'existing setups never asked' and 'cluster local works offline' claims do not alter the add-on hold socket or the GPU-limit root path.
(3) The note that pair approvals are capped at 64, newest release first, concerns coordinator-owned policy and is outside this repo's scope. The note that the registration is unchanged from 0.10.9 is consistent with no change to TB-002 or TB-011 evidence.
(4) The changelog says the waitlist join 'sends nothing about the Mac'. This privacy claim should be checked against the actual implementation, which is not supplied here (T-058 identity linkage).

The claims are unverifiable from this diff alone. They are recorded as integration questions rather than findings, because the changelog is documentation and no behavior is observed. Also noted: the patch excerpt is truncated at the 0.10.10 rollout notes, but the base text shows the rest is existing 0.10.9 content.
